features: [FEATURE]:These embroidered Chirstmas Snowman shaped placemats are with colorful applique and elelgant embroidery. These mats are for Chirstmas holiday, environmental friendly and durable. These beautiful stylish placemats will add more fun to your dining table. Made by our Oeko-Tex certified factory.

[ENHANCE YOUR ROOM]: The lovely Christmas placemats could be used all through the holiday! They are very suitable for breakfast nooks, kitchen counters, dining tables and entryway tables to instantly decorate your room. Also suitablelidayor the living room, bedroom, barn, woodland, vint table. Good for everyday use, parties, Harvest, Halloween, Christmas, holidays etc.

[EASY TO CLEAN]: 100% Polyester. This placemat is easy to clean: Machine wash cold in gentle cycle with like colors. Only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry low. Remove promptly. Cool iron as needed.
